facts.fact: 周六晨 Yna 想取消，Elizabeth 冷面拒绝推她去浴室，主动照看 Michael 和 Lynne
8:30 AM 到达停车场，背包两瓶水一个苹果一份压扁火鸡三明治
facts.anchor: At 8:30 AM, Yna pulled her van into the Blue Ridge Trailhead North Parking Lot.

facts.fact: Marcus 撺掇下第一次当面叫 Kai；他把咖啡点心塞给她自己开车下山
facts.anchor: Yna flushed slightly, shifting her weight. "Good morning... Kai."

facts.fact: 登山途中她体力不支喘气，Kai 收紧她背包胸带说慢慢来、自己不会先走
facts.anchor: It's not a mountain, Yna. It's a trail

facts.fact: Kai 告知 half a mile 上观景台，十分钟后登上俯瞰山谷高地她连声道谢
facts.anchor: There's a lookout about half a mile up

facts.fact: Yna 说大女儿 fourteen 就掌管生活；Kai 重复 fourteen 称那是危险年纪
facts.anchor: She's fourteen and already runs my life

facts.fact: 山顶野餐 Kai 用拇指拂去她脸颊面包屑，令她心跳加速
facts.anchor: His thumb brushed against her cheek, feather-light and careful

facts.fact: 【转折】年轻情侣主动合影，照片里 Kai 低头凝视 Yna；她按红心存进收藏
facts.anchor: And Kai—Kai wasn't looking at the camera at all.
